meta_description: The summary and lessons of Heidi, Spyri's original story, plus read-aloud tips to teach your child a bright heart and the preciousness of nature. A classic fairy tale guide for ages 4-7.

content.alt: Heidi - What kind of story is Heidi?
content.text:
What kind of story is Heidi?

Heidi is the story of a bright-hearted girl who comes to live with her gruff grandfather in the Alps and, with her pure heart, changes the people around her. It shows the power of innocence and a warm heart in the midst of nature.

content.alt: Heidi - The original story of Heidi
content.text:
The original story of Heidi

This is a novel published in 1880-1881 by the Swiss author Johanna Spyri. Heidi, who has lost her parents, is entrusted to her grandfather in the Alps, and she grows up spending her days with the goatherd Peter and the goats. It leads into a moving story in which Clara, a girl from the city, visits the mountains and regains her health.

content.text:
A summary of the Heidi plot

Heidi, who has come to her grandfather in the Alps, is delighted with the hay bed her gruff grandfather makes for her, saying it feels "like a cloud." Spending happy days with the goatherd Peter and the goats, she cheerfully adjusts to mountain life, and with her bright, kind heart she gradually opens up the hearts of her grandfather and the people around her.

content.text:
The lessons of Heidi

The heart of it is that a bright and pure heart can open even a closed heart, and the joy of growing up healthy in nature is precious. Try connecting it to your child's own experience with, "How did you feel when you went somewhere new?"

content.alt: Heidi - How to read it to your child
content.text:
How to read it to your child

At the Alpine scenery scenes, stir the senses with, "How fresh do you think the mountain air is?" and "What do you think the goats sound like?" Reading with a contrast between the gruff grandfather's voice and bright Heidi's voice makes the change stand out clearly. Suitable for ages 4-7.

content.text:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Q. What age is Heidi good for?
A. It's suitable for ages 4-7. With the feeling of nature and warm relationships, it's a story that puts the heart at ease.

Q. Is it the same as Heidi, Girl of the Alps?
A. Yes, it's the same work. It's simply called by a different title.

Q. What activities pair well with it?
A. Drawing mountain scenery, imitating nature sounds, and talking about "a time you adjusted to somewhere new" all work well.
